answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Work waits on the beacon until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the spiral of the next round. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, slashed on a failed audit, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the delta of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
